records.access_notes: Malta Botanical Gardens official summer 07:00–19:00 and winter 07:00–17:00. This is not an overnight park, and heritage works may restrict sections.

records.name: Toilet near abandond hotel
records.description_rewritten: A generic restroom allegedly near an abandoned hotel in Marsaskala. The former Jerma Palace Hotel is an important local derelict property, but the available source does not definitively identify it as the hotel meant. The Jerma site is the subject of an active October–November 2026 environmental consultation ahead of proposed demolition and redevelopment, so access cannot be presumed.
records.location_context: Marsaskala (Marsa Scala), Malta; unverified toilet and uncertain link to former Jerma Hotel.
records.access_notes: Potentially deteriorated/private derelict property. Entry to unsafe hotel structures should not be encouraged; any nearby public toilet must be independently located.
